newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rato says Spanish economy began recovery in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Rato says Spanish economy began recovery in Q3.

text.p: The Spanish economy entered a recovery phase in the third quarter of the year, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday.
"The recovery has been taking place in the third quarter," said Rato in a brief news conference at a seminar.
Data on third quarter gross domestic product have yet to be released. In the second quarter, Spanish GDP recorded 1.9 percent growth over the corresponding quarter of 1995.
The government has forecast 2.3 percent GDP growth for this year as a whole and is aiming for three percent in 1997.
